escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a dark studio at night): a Latin American RevOps lead in her mid thirties, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, wearing the NAVY EFEONCE SOFTSHELL JACKET over the navy polo, stands with her body centred at about 62 % of the frame width, her head in the upper-middle of the frame, framed from the waist up, looking straight into the lens with a confident half-smile, one open hand raised toward a glowing knot of light beside her as if steering it. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm. Around her flows a BOW-TIE made of streams of light that runs DIAGONALLY and stays inside the RIGHT 70% of the frame: from the upper right background thousands of tiny glowing particles pour in and converge, narrowing into one brilliant knot of light next to her raised hand, and from that knot the streams open out again downward toward the lower foreground, wider and brighter, like a revenue engine that keeps growing after the sale. The streams are cool azure blue (#0375DB) and cool white, the light of Efeonce; only a few small magenta-pink (#E86BD0) particles ride along them as a sparse accent, never more than one in twenty. The knot blazes cool white-blue and lights her face, hand and jacket with cool light. Riding along the streams, THREE Sparks, each smaller than her head and above her waist: one, copied EXACTLY from the first Spark reference, surfs a stream toward the knot, sharp; one, the Content Spark copied EXACTLY from its reference, carries its small glowing card, sharp; and ONE more Spark (THREE in total, never more), the same figure as the Spark references, farther back along the stream, smaller and out of focus, gives a thumbs-up. Cool rim light from behind, haze catching the colored streams. The LEFT 30% of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze: no streams, no Sparks, no objects. Rich contrast, punchy color, no text, no logos of any other brand. COMPOSITION FOR A WEBSITE MENU (native to its frame): this vertical photo sits in the right column of a full-screen menu whose dark panel overlaps its LEFT third with a large curved corner at the top; so the SUBJECT and everything that carries the idea sits in the CENTRE-RIGHT of the frame, and the left third is calm continuation of the same scene, never empty and never a flat slab.
